# owner: platform
"""Contact sheet for substitute teachers."""

from typing import List

from rosterkit.models import Student
from rosterkit.errors import ProjectError


# ---
def contact_rows(students: List[Student]) -> List[str]:
    """Return rows of name, section and email in columns."""
    if not students:
        raise ProjectError("no students for contact sheet")
    for student in students:
        if not student.email:
            raise ProjectError(
                f"no email for {student.display_name}"
            )
    ordered = sorted(
        students, key=lambda item: item.display_name
    )
    name_width = max(len(item.display_name) for item in ordered)
    sect_width = max(len(item.section) for item in ordered)
    return [
        f"{item.display_name:<{name_width}}  "
        f"{item.section:<{sect_width}}  {item.email}"
        for item in ordered
    ]
EOF

# owner: platform
import unittest

from rosterkit.models import Student
from rosterkit.errors import ProjectError
from rosterkit.contacts import contact_rows


def make_student(last, first, section, email):
    return Student("id-" + last, last, first, section, email)


class ContactRowTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_rows_are_sorted_and_aligned(self):
        rows = contact_rows(
            [
                make_student("Young", "Al", "B", "al@x.org"),
                make_student("Adams", "Bea", "A", "bea@x.org")
            ]
        )
        self.assertEqual(
            rows,
            [
                "Adams, Bea  A  bea@x.org",
                "Young, Al   B  al@x.org"
            ]
        )

    def test_missing_email_names_student(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ProjectError) as caught:
            contact_rows([make_student("Adams", "Bea", "A", None)])
        self.assertIn("Adams, Bea", str(caught.exception))

    def test_empty_list_raises(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ProjectError):
            contact_rows([])
EOF
